svg.text: 20 tasks · 3 benchmarks · 2 hosts × 3 setups · 1 run each
Host $ what the host model itself uses, at API list price: the part that
comes out of your Claude or ChatGPT plan.
Worker $ stacked on top. Subagents bill the host's plan; agy is priced at
Gemini list price but runs on agy's own quota.
Per trial the mean over the benchmark's tasks, as in the table. The number
over each bar is host + worker.
Versions agy-staff 0.7.3 (f00d149) / 0.8.0 (90596bc), agy CLI 1.3.0 in every
